## Episode Thesis

This is a sponsored personal-finance episode with Christopher Bolin, co-founder and CEO of Comfy Living, an app for booking tradespeople. It covers which renovations to do yourself and which to leave to professionals, typical tradesperson costs (about 1,000 SEK/hour including everything), ROT/RUT tax deductions, and fixed-price versus hourly billing. There is no stock-market discussion and no investment views on any listed company; company mentions are ads, sponsors, or consumer-product references.
